title: Reject bank statements containing unclosed CSV quotes
public_pr_body:
An unclosed quoted amount such as `"100.00` was accepted as a £100 transaction with no error. Reject the structurally broken statement before returning any transactions, including valid rows preceding the broken field. Valid escaped quotes and multiline fields remain supported.

Follow-up to #109/#120, stacked on #120 to reuse its existing regression tests. Original branches untouched; ownership handoff authorised by Rhys and published in #130, with atomic claim claims/pr109-csv-quotes.

Validation: four new regressions failed before the fix; all 44 bank tests pass after it and again on commit 72b3e22. TypeScript, targeted ESLint and git diff --check pass. No database, payment write, migration or deployment changes. Integration CI remains to be verified.
